[§ IL Cheat Sheet §]

[=How IL Sits In The Repo=]

- surface [*.SPO*] lowers to [*mIL_AST.tModule*]
- [*.ILT*] is the shared backend text boundary
- canonical examples live in [*SPO_CS/Modules/*.ILT*] and [*SPO_CS/Regression.Tests/*.ILT*]

[=Module Shape=]

[.ilt
|§TYPES
|    t_0 := [EMPTY_TYPE => BOOL]
|    t_1 := [EMPTY_TYPE => t_0]
|
|§DEF d_0 € t_1
|    r_0 := FALSE
|    §RETURN r_0 IF TRUE
.]

- all type definitions come first
- each [.ilt|§DEF.] has an id, a type id, and a command body
- the last definition is the module init / entry proc

[=Common Names=]

- [.ilt|t_*.] compiler-assigned type ids
- [.ilt|d_*.] compiler-assigned def ids
- [.ilt|r_*.] register ids
- [.ilt|_Name.] lowered user-visible names and import fields

Common fixed values that appear directly in IL:

- [.ilt|EMPTY.]
- [.ilt|TRUE.], [.ilt|FALSE.]
- [.ilt|ONE.]
- [.ilt|ARG.], [.ilt|ENV.], [.ilt|OBJ.], [.ilt|RES.]
- runtime type values such as [.ilt|INT_TYPE.] and [.ilt|BOOL_TYPE.] may appear in type-literal lowering

[=Common Type Forms=]

[.ilt
|EMPTY_TYPE
|BOOL
|INT
|[A, B]
|[A | B]
|[#Tag A]
|[Arg => Res]
|[Obj : [Arg => Res]]
|[§VAR A]
|[§FREE]
|[§REC t => Body]
|[§ALL t => Body]
|[§ANY t => Body]
|[.tGeneric tValue]
.]

Notes:

- IL uses [.ilt|§REC.], [.ilt|§ALL.], and [.ilt|§ANY.] where SPO surface syntax uses [.ilt|§RECURSIVE.], [.ilt|§GENERIC.], and [.ilt|§INTERFACE.].
- method types in IL are written as object type plus function type, for example [.ilt|[[tObj : [tArg => tRes]]]].]
- [.ilt|[[A & Proof]].] is parser-visible as [.ilt|TypeCond.], but it is not fully finished end-to-end

[=Common Command Forms=]

[.ilt
|r_1 := 1
|r_2 := TRUE
|r_3 := r_1, r_2
|r_4 := §1ST r_3
|r_5 := §2ND r_3
|r_6 := +#Result r_5
|r_7 := {rec} #Field
|r_8 := .Func ARG
|r_9 := §OBJ:Method ARG
|r_10 := §VAR r_1
|r_11 := §VAR r_10 ->
|§VAR r_10 <- r_1
|§RETURN r_11 IF TRUE
|§RETURN r_11 IF_NOT_EMPTY
|r_12 := §TRY ARG AS_EMPTY
.]

The forms you will see most often in checked-in `.ILT` files are:

- register assignment
- tuple/pair decomposition via [.ilt|§1ST.] and [.ilt|§2ND.]
- prefix construction and removal via [.ilt|+#Tag.] and [.ilt|-#Tag.]
- function calls via [.ilt|.name arg.]
- method-style calls via [.ilt|§OBJ:name arg.]
- var create/get/set via [.ilt|§VAR.]
- conditional return via [.ilt|§RETURN value IF cond.] or [.ilt|IF_NOT_EMPTY.]
- match helpers encoded through [.ilt|#Result ...] versus [.ilt|EMPTY.]

[=Parser-Visible Extras=]

[.ilt
|r_1 := §TRY x AS_BOOL
|r_2 := §TRY x AS_INT
|r_3 := §TRY x AS_PAIR
|r_4 := §TRY x AS_RECORD
|r_5 := §TRY x AS_VAR
|r_6 := §TRY x AS_REF
|r_7 := §TRY x AS_TYPE
|r_8 := §TRY_REMOVE #Tag FROM x
.]

[=SPO vs IL Notation=]

[| [*Concept*]    ][ [*SPO*]                      ][ [*IL*]                           |]
[| recursive type ][ [.spo|[[§RECURSIVE t T]].]   ][ [.ilt|[[§REC t => T]].]          |]
[| generic type   ][ [.spo|[[§GENERIC t T]].]     ][ [.ilt|[[§ALL t => T]].]          |]
[| interface type ][ [.spo|[[§INTERFACE t T]].]   ][ [.ilt|[[§ANY t => T]].]          |]
[| method type    ][ [.spo|[[Obj : Arg => Res]].] ][ [.ilt|[[Obj : [[Arg => Res]]]].] |]
